items.title: Manhattan prosecutors charge three over $129M AI CEO-impersonation fraud
items.summary: Federal prosecutors in Manhattan charged three men over an alleged $129 million scheme using AI to imitate CEOs. Arrested in Spain and the UK.
items.why_it_matters: Deepfake CEO fraud hits mid-sized companies.

October US jobs report resilient while AI-linked layoffs continue; unemployment expectations hit highest since 2020
items.summary: October payrolls rose by 165,000 and unemployment fell to 4.1%. NY Fed data shows expectations of higher unemployment a year ahead rose to 45.3%, the highest since April 2020. Challenger counted 43,994 announced layoffs in October, down 71% year on year.
items.why_it_matters: Gap between strong labour data and worker anxiety about AI.

items.title: Banks' AI adoption: privacy concerns fall sharply, but few report measurable returns
items.summary: Financial Brand piece says community-bank concern about data privacy dropped nearly 22 points between 2025 and 2026. Evident's AI Index: only 12% of use cases report KPI impact, ~1% concrete financial returns. Unverified, page 403.
items.why_it_matters: Adoption broad, proof of return thin.
